annotations.text: The flow: toggle targets in the top band, then press pads to put things on the selection. Every pad is a toggle (press again to remove); long-press would configure an effect or release a value, as on the current FX view. The presence ring language is unchanged: off / partial / lit. Try it — the artboard is clickable, including GO.

Speed-master model changes this leans on:

• Default usage — a busked effect with no explicit master follows the master whose usage matches its family (movement chase → M2). That is what lets the pads stay one press: no speed picker per press.

• Time signature — a master can follow M1 at a ratio (½, ⅓, ¼…). One TAP on M1 retunes the whole show; linked masters trade their TAP for ratio chips.

The sheet artboard on the left is where both are set.

Two rougher layout directions in case the main arrangement doesn't feel right at the desk: A keeps a scrolling target rail on the left (more targets visible, narrower pads); B pages the pools MA-style (biggest pads, but a mode switch per family). Happy to build either out instead.
